verdict.rationale: Martin is explicitly designed to be operated via natural-language commands across email, Slack, text, and desktop interfaces (e.g., 'Text Jon my arrival time', 'Cc Martin to schedule a meeting', 'Tell Martin to remind you...'), with first-party corroboration from hands-on community use ('handling complicated requests correctly the first time', using it via Slack/VSC aside). Missing for 10: independent third-party benchmarking of NL command accuracy and broader coverage beyond anecdotal HN comments.
